digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess environment management
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, risking unintended scope writes and credential leakage to sibling children

Jira Cloud scope maintains implicit DIG fallbacks across four locations (write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, create-time default) that can activate when no explicit project is configured
Rebar adapters mutate global os.environ and lack a mechanism to isolate adapter-specific secrets from unrelated sibling child processes
Missing project or authentication produces no pre-mutation validation error; requests may target DIG by default even when write scope is absent
Configuration, Git/AWS/SSH/proxy/CA environment variables and adapter overlays are not reliably threaded through applier, mutation planning, handlers, binding updates, and delivery paths
